evidence.text: NOAAGlobalTemp is the dataset underlying NOAA's monthly global climate reports, combining land surface air temperature (Global Historical Climatology Network-Monthly, GHCN-M) and sea surface temperature data (Extended Reconstructed Sea Surface Temperature, ERSST). It produces global land-and-ocean, land-only, and ocean-only temperature anomaly time series. Version 6.1.0 uses the current WMO climatological standard normals period 1991-2020 as the reference period for temperature anomalies; the data are provided as anomalies relative to a 1991-2020 monthly climatology.
